records.issue_text: [Critical/security] app/models/post.rb:131 — `cook` returns `raw` unmodified for `raw_html` posts and imported RSS content is stored unsanitized, allowing stored XSS via scripts/iframes in feeds; raw HTML must be sanitized before persistence or rendering
records.rationale: The mechanism is fully visible in the diff: PollFeed imports RSS content into TopicEmbed.import, which passes it to PostCreator with cook_method raw_html and skip_validations; Post#cook then returns `raw` unmodified for raw_html posts, and the embed view renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. No sanitization step (e.g., the sanitize gem) is applied to imported content anywhere in this diff, so a malicious feed could inject script/iframe HTML that is stored and rendered as-is — a stored XSS introduced by this change.

records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:7 — page reloads every 30 seconds forever with no error state when retrieval fails (network error, invalid feed, user not configured)
records.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable: loading.html.erb reloads via setTimeout every 30000ms unconditionally, and embed_controller renders 'loading' whenever no topic_id exists, so if TopicEmbed.import never succeeds (bad feed, missing user, unreachable host), the embedded iframe reloads forever with no error state. It's a borderline design limitation rather than a hard defect, so confidence is moderate.

records.issue_text: [Low/performance] app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` has no open/read timeout or size limit; a slow or huge feed blocks the scheduled job thread and retries pile up
records.rationale: The diff does show `rss = SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` in poll_feed.rb with no timeout option, so the core mechanism (a slow/hanging feed fetch blocks the job thread, and jobs are enqueued hourly) is grounded and real. Note one part of the finding is contradicted: the diff sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so 'retries pile up' is inaccurate. Still, the lack of an open/read timeout on a network fetch in a scheduled job is a specific, decision-relevant operational concern, not a bug per se.

records.issue_text: [Medium/security] app/models/topic_embed.rb:17 — raw URL is interpolated into single-quoted HTML attributes without escaping, allowing attribute breakout and injected markup/XSS in imported posts
records.rationale: TopicEmbed.import appends `link: "#{url}"` with the URL interpolated directly into a single-quoted HTML attribute. The only validation is `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which permits single quotes, spaces, and markup (e.g. `http://x/' onmouseover='...`), enabling attribute breakout and arbitrary markup injection. The post is then created with cook_method raw_html, and Post#cook returns raw unmodified, so the injected HTML is stored and rendered verbatim. This is a real, verifiable XSS/injection defect introduced by this diff.
